description: Panel CB-4 rated 200A is running at 312A peak load per clamp-meter reading. Two circuit breakers show heat discoloration. Immediate de-rating or load-balancing required.

Detected ammonia concentration 38 ppm at floor level (OSHA PEL 50 ppm; IDLH 300 ppm). One PRV valve on the condensing unit shows crystalline deposit consistent with slow leak. Refrigerant log shows 22 lbs loss in 90 days with no documented repair.
Emergency exit door blocked by three pallets of raw steel stock. Exit sign illuminated but door physically non-operable. NFPA 101 requires clear path at all times.
Model RG-100 press-brake operating without point-of-operation guard or light curtain. OSHA 29 CFR 1910.217 requires mechanical power-press guarding. No lockout-tagout procedure posted at machine.
Cardboard debris and shrink-wrap accumulation over 400 sq ft of aisle. Not immediately life-safety critical but presents elevated fire load.
Emergency action plan last updated 2019; does not reflect cold storage ammonia system added in 2022. Required update under 29 CFR 1910.38.
